purpose: Teach: 伊達/沸い/問答/贈ら/リスナー/河原/ペダル/バク

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、伊達メガネ、絶対、お洒落、絶対、流行ってるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心
lines.en: Aoi, those fake glasses are seriously so stylish and on-trend right now—I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, admiring opening. Lean in slightly. Bright but genuine—not gossipy, sincere. Light energy throughout, landing softly on the appreciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵のお客様、本気で、絶対、新作で、絶対、沸いてるよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Yeah, and my customers are actually going crazy over the new frames—it makes me really happy, honestly.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Quick pulse of delight at the mention of customers. Maintains directness—sharing something real, not performing. Slight lift at the end, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、問答、絶対、無用で、彼、絶対、優しいのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Your boyfriend is just genuinely so kind about all of it—I'm really grateful for how supportive he is of you.
lines.style: Soft, steady tone. Slower pace. Lands with quiet sincerity on 'kind'—no exaggeration. Breath easy, trailing warmth. Speaking from the heart, not for effect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様から、本気で、絶対、お花、絶対、贈られたのよ、葵で、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感激
lines.en: Actually, a customer sent me flowers today—I was so touched when I found out.
lines.style: Lit up with genuine surprise. Quick delivery on the main point. Slight catch of emotion on 'flowers'—not overdone, just present. Ends with soft wonder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ラジオのリスナー、絶対、増えてるって、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And apparently your radio audience is really growing—it's impressive how much people are tuning in.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, conversational. Steady pace. No inflation—just stating something factual with real warmth underneath. Slight emphasis on 'growing' without pushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 河原で、本気で、絶対、ピクニック、絶対、彼と、絶対、行ったって、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、ロマンチック
lines.en: You two went on a picnic by the river together—that sounds so romantic.
lines.style: Soft, slightly dreamy quality. Slower pace. Voice carries a touch of wistfulness—not envious, just touched by the sweetness of it. Tender trailing-off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼、本気で、絶対、自転車のペダル、絶対、漕ぐの、絶対、得意なのよ、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And he's really good at cycling too—I honestly think he's got such great skills.
lines.style: Bright with genuine admiration. Natural conversational rhythm. Quick emphasis on 'good'—approving without flattery. Light, warm energy throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 動物園で、本気で、絶対、バク、絶対、見たわよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、可愛い
lines.en: We saw a tapir at the zoo the other day and it was absolutely adorable.
lines.style: Cheerful, bright delivery. Slight acceleration at 'tapir'—the delight of the memory. Warm closing with soft affection. Like sharing something small and sweet with a friend.
